create or alter procedure graph.GetLineageByAsset @assetUid uniqueidentifier, @startFromAssets varchar(2500) = null, @direction int = 1, --1 = Forward, 2 = Backward, 3 = Both @hops int = 5 as begin set nocount on;
-- Validation if @hops > 25 begin set @hops = 25 end if @hops <= 0 begin set @hops = 3 end if @direction not between 1 and 3 begin set @direction = 3 end
drop table if exists #tbl drop table if exists #clean create table #tbl ([Hop] int, Uid uniqueidentifier, FromHop decimal, FromID bigint, subjectUid uniqueidentifier, FromPath nvarchar(2500), FromSegment xml, ToHop decimal, ToID bigint, objectUid uniqueidentifier, ToPath nvarchar(2500), ToSegment xml, predicateUid uniqueidentifier, [predicate] nvarchar(250), predicateType int) create table #clean ([Hop] int, ID bigint, [Path] nvarchar(2500), Segment xml) create index ix_TempTbl on #tbl ([Hop] desc, ToID asc)
declare @assetId bigint, @level int=0, @current int=1, @max int = @hops*2 -- (* 2) because we have to include the hop through the transformation asset
select @assetId = ID from Asset where Uid = @assetUid
if @assetId is null begin set @assetId = 0; end
insert into #tbl ([Hop], ToID) values (@level, @assetId)
--Backward lineage set @level = 0 set @current = 1 if @direction = 2 or @direction = 3 begin while @current <= @max begin set @level = @level + 1
insert into #tbl select @level as [Hop], E.Uid, case when @level = 1 then cast(@level as decimal) else cast(@level-.5 as decimal) end as [FromHop], S.ID as FromID, S.Uid, S.[Path] as FromPath, S.[Segments] as FromSegments, cast(@level+.5 as decimal) as ToHop, T.ID as ToID, T.Uid, T.[Path] as ToPath, T.[Segments] as ToSegments,
E.PredicateUid, P.Name, E.PredicateType
from graph.AssetNode S, graph.AssetEdge E, graph.AssetNode T, #tbl J, [Predicate] P where MATCH(S<-(E)-T) and J.[Hop] = @level-1 and J.ToID = S.ID and E.PredicateID = P.ID
set @current = @current+1 end end
--Forward lineage set @level = 0 set @current = 1 if @direction = 1 or @direction = 3 begin while @current <= @max begin set @level = @level + 1
insert into #tbl select @level as [Hop], E.Uid, case when @level = 1 then cast(@level as decimal) else cast(@level-.5 as decimal) end as [FromHop], S.ID as FromID, S.Uid, S.[Path] as FromPath, S.[Segments] as FromSegments, cast(@level+.5 as decimal) as ToHop, T.ID as ToID, T.Uid, T.[Path] as ToPath, T.[Segments] as ToSegments,
E.PredicateUid, P.Name, E.PredicateType
from graph.AssetNode S, graph.AssetEdge E, graph.AssetNode T, #tbl J, [Predicate] P where MATCH(S-(E)->T) and J.[Hop] = @level-1 and J.ToID = S.ID and E.PredicateID = P.ID
set @current = @current+1 end end
delete #tbl where Hop = 0
insert into #clean select FromHop, FromID, FromPath, FromSegment from #tbl
insert into #clean select N.ToHop, N.ToID, N.ToPath, N.ToSegment from #tbl N left join #clean E on E.Hop = N.ToHop and E.ID = N.ToID where E.ID is null
drop table if exists #hierarchies create table #hierarchies ([Hop] int, ID bigint, Back varchar(25), Fore varchar(25), HierarchyLevel int, AssetTypeID int, AssetID bigint, AssetUid uniqueidentifier, DisplayValue nvarchar(500), Class int, AssetTypeName nvarchar(250), Reveal bit, RelationCounts varchar(max)) create index ix_TempHierarchies on #hierarchies ([Hop] asc, HierarchyLevel asc)
-- Hierarchies insert into #hierarchies select T.[Hop], --'F', T.ID, coalesce(S.[IconBackColor], '#000000'), coalesce(S.[IconForeColor], '#FFFFFF'), doc.c.value('@level', 'int') as [HierarchyLevel], doc.c.value('@assetTypeId', 'int') as [assetTypeId], doc.c.value('@assetId', 'bigint') as [assetId], A.Uid, d.DisplayValue, [AT].Class, [AT].Name as AssetTypeName, cast(0 as bit), '[]' from #clean T cross apply T.Segment.nodes('/path/segment') doc(c) inner join AssetDisplayValue d on d.AssetID = doc.c.value('@assetId', 'bigint') inner join AssetType [AT] on [AT].ID = doc.c.value('@assetTypeId', 'int') left join ObjectStyle S on S.ObjectType = [AT].Object and S.ObjectID = [AT].ObjectID inner join Asset A on A.ID = d.AssetID; update T set T.Reveal = iif(S.[Count] > 0, 1, 0) from #hierarchies T inner join ( select J.AssetID, count(1) as [Count] from graph.AssetNode S, graph.AssetEdge E, graph.AssetNode T, ( select h.* from #hierarchies h inner join ( select max(Hop) as Hop, Max(HierarchyLevel) as HierarchyLevel from #hierarchies ) mh on mh.Hop = h.Hop and mh.HierarchyLevel = h.HierarchyLevel ) J where MATCH(S-(E)->T) and J.AssetID = S.ID group by J.AssetID ) S on S.AssetID = T.AssetID
-- Direct lineage select * from #clean order by Hop;
-- Hierarchies select * from #hierarchies order by Hop, ID, HierarchyLevel;
-- Links select [Hop], Uid, subjectUid, FromID as subjectId, objectUid, ToID as objectId, predicateUid, [predicate], predicateType from #tbl order by Hop; end
